title: Typed captured mesh fields, explicit domain transfer and linear color consumption

supportedProfile: Versioned immutable scalar/vec2/vec3/color mesh attributes on explicit vertex, face and corner domains
Topology-bound attribute data with exact ordered index/vertex-count/revision identity; detached copies for consumers
Bundle0.3 meshAttributes operations deriving resource outputs through ordered capture, explicit transfer and set-position steps
Shared-time scalar expressions with bounded parameters; explicit linear-sRGB color attribute material selection in the GPU consumer
excluded: Arbitrary Blender fields, automatic domain coercion, edge/instance/spline domains and anonymous attribute propagation
Topology edits, remeshing, interpolation across unrelated meshes and automatic normals reconstruction after deformation
Textures, lighting, alpha-blended attributes, arbitrary shaders or a full material-node system
Complete Blender output equivalence and identical raster bytes across GPUs/browsers

upstream.role: Capturing field results makes their values belong to the produced geometry. Texloom uses explicit persistent names and immutable buffers, rather than importing Blender anonymous-attribute graph machinery.

license.note: Pinned primary source and execution symbol inspected for conceptual scope. No implementation is copied or translated; later source adaptation requires a separate file-level license review.

upstream.role: Attribute domain is part of field evaluation context. Texloom exposes a small explicit transfer registry and does not silently perform every Blender domain adaptation.

inputs: An existing authored or generated source mesh, unique output resource ID and explicit units matching the source
Named capture steps with explicit domain and scalar/vector/color type; dimensionless coordinate expressions and typed source time
Named transfer steps specifying target domain and a registered method; no implicit conversion
Optional set-position triples with normalPolicy drop; fixed topology and prior captured values remain unchanged
At most16 operations,32 steps per operation,128 total steps; ordinary mesh and attribute storage budgets remain enforced
outputs: Generated resources are evaluated in dependency order; declarations remain portable and authored resources are not mutated
Attribute buffer counts match explicit domain sizes, with topology revision, vertex count and complete ordered converted index snapshot
Linear RGB colors remain in[0,1]; selected vertex colors interpolate, face colors repeat over the three rendered corners
Original operation JSON, exact original step ranges and decoded component expressions are archived with source spans
coordinates: Mesh coordinates stay object-local in explicit units; node/camera transforms and output color encoding are downstream consumer concerns
Vertex-to-face mean is the arithmetic average of the triangle's three referenced vertex values in their stored numeric/color space
Set-position changes positions and bounds, removes stale normals explicitly and retains already captured attribute arrays
Native TeX overlays and both comparison meshes use the common absolute scene clock
errorPolicy: Reject unsupported domain/method pairs, missing names, source cycles, duplicate output IDs and mismatched units
Reject nonfinite field values, invalid color ranges, type/count mismatches, invalid buffers and topology changes under captured attributes
Unreferenced/zero-area aggregation behavior must follow explicit supported orphan and zero-area policies
Literal capture rejects duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite values, reserved source metadata, unsafe sidecar paths and size/step budgets before bundle publication

verification.command: python -m unittest tests.attribute_port_spec_test tests.attribute_capture_test tests.attribute_player_test -v; npm test
claims: Real TeX derives smooth vertex-colored and explicit face-mean-colored spheres from one generated source without authored RGB buffers
Independent tests compute every captured scalar/color and triangle mean from source coordinates and time
Browser tests independently project visible triangle interiors and compare linear interpolation versus flat face color after sRGB encoding
Same-browser reverse PNGs, radius regeneration, mobile layout and untouched authored source are checked
The feature-specific PortSpec registry leaves historical2D raster goldens unchanged
notEstablished: Execution or numeric equivalence of Blender's complete field/domain conversion system
All nonlinear field singularities outside sampled vertices or faces
Automatic interpolation correctness after topology changes or arbitrary mesh correspondence
Cross-browser, cross-device or cross-driver pixel identity
